name: Britannia Industries Limited
remarksWeb: While uploading the shareholding pattern, we encountered a validation error due to a duplicate PAN (AAACL0582H) under the category Public Shareholding - Any other (Specify) for Life Insurance Corporation of India. Reason for duplication: The reported PAN AAACL0582H is the only PAN available for the corporate entity named Life Insurance Corporation of India. Since LIC floats various schemes/funds under various names, the PAN issued to Life Insurance Corporation of India and LIC ULIP Growth Fund is same in the shareholding pattern filed by the Company. To resolve the validation error, the PAN has been removed under the Any other sub-category, while the overall shareholding remains unchanged.
